steps.title: Analyze and Plan Extended App Features
steps.description: Examine the base 3D project to map out a highly requested educational expansion containing tracing paintbrush custom colors, brush thickness, and an interactive 3D Memory Card Game.

steps.title: Update Main Layout Workspace Structure
steps.description: Refactor activity_main.xml to introduce a horizontal brush customization bar in the tracing workspace, a full game container for the 3D memory game, and a balanced 4-tab bottom navigation controller.

steps.title: Verify Android Build Properties & SDKs
steps.description: Re-verify build.gradle file specifications to confirm compliance with target SDK 34 and AGP 8.3.2 standards without introducing external libraries.

steps.title: Upgrade Painting View with Custom Attributes
steps.description: Extend DrawingView properties to support dynamic paint colors and brush size stroke widths chosen dynamically by children.

steps.title: Build Trace Brush Color Setup Methods
steps.description: Create helper function inside MainActivity to programmatically generate 3D rounded color circle targets for brush selection.

steps.title: Design Brush Stroke Size Selector
steps.description: Implement a custom toggle button in Tracing mode with auditory feedback that rotates through thin, medium, and thick stencil settings.

steps.title: Implement 3D Card-Flip Animation Logic
steps.description: Program a lightweight, native 3D horizontal scale animation handler that compresses and expands grid items to mimic a tactile toy block turning over.

steps.title: Develop 3D Memory Grid State Machine
steps.description: Program game logic for shuffling 6 random letter pairs, tracking revealed/matched cards, and handling interactive card matching sequences.

steps.title: Construct Custom Memory Match Adapter
steps.description: Design the MemoryAdapter class to dynamically output tactile facedown cards with questions marks and high-contrast letter pairs when solved.

steps.title: Enhance Text-to-Speech Cheering Systems
steps.description: Integrate congratulatory speech audio lines when matching pairs are successfully uncovered to enhance kid engagement.

steps.title: Update Bottom Navigation Bar Layout
steps.description: Re-wire tab listeners to include the brand-new 3D Matching game while preserving the skeuomorphic press highlights.

steps.title: Validate Namespace and Application Metadata
steps.description: Perform safety check on the standard Android manifest headers to ensure proper application launch constraints are met.

steps.title: Building Alphabet Explorer
steps.description: Run standard Gradle assembleDebug execution parameters to generate the highly optimized expanded 3D learning platform.
